alliance.summary: Accepted positive alliance (state2/value true) allocates0x48 and installs relation vtable1c7a740; +10/+18 are its two full country handles. a5d1b0 registers the same relation in both root80/8c indexes via a68c20. a5d790 unregisters both and marks removed; symmetric presence cannot identify which proposal created it.

military.summary: Military relation ctor a70100 creates vtable1cdde60 (0x48 bytes at both action allocations). Relation+10 is access holder and +18 grantor. milaccess copies action actor/recipient directly, offermilaccess reverses those relation fields. Both creation paths require state2/value true. a70270 registers holder rootb0/bc througha68ee0 and grantor rootc8/d4 througha69060. a70310 clears both indexes and writes removed+28=1.

fleet.summary: Fleet relation ctor a70670 creates vtable1cddee0 (0x48 bytes). Relation+10 is basing holder, +18 port grantor. fleet_access copies actor/recipient; offer_fleet_access reverses them. Both require state2/value true. a70760 registers holder roote0/ec througha693f0 and grantor rootf8/104 througha695a0. a70840 clears both and marks removed+28=1.

enforce_peace_flag.summary: Both access relation constructors initialize BYTE+40=0; shared serializer/parser names it enforce_peace, token2dda. It is not an automatic/conditional access flag. The selected observer reports flag1 separately and does not treat it as ordinary diplomatic proposal effect.

conditional_access_is_separate.summary: The conditional-access UI calls a69030, which forwards to rule evaluator28b220. That evaluator can return true for same country/root50 relations before rootb0; after no b0 match it continues into overlord and further rule paths. Thus effective movement permission is not equivalent to an indexed explicit military agreement. The observer reads b0/c8 objects only; it does not evaluate movement permission or infer no conditional access when the object is absent.

subsidy_selected_effect.summary: Positive effect547880 allocates a persistent0x48 relation with vtable1c815d8, writes payer+10, payee+18, start+20, amount+40 and duration+44, and registers the same object in both pair directions througha697a0. Pair lookupa698f0 uses root+110/count+11c. Cancellation finds the relation via recipient's pair record, calls a62f80, clears both index links and marks relation+28=1. A future cancellation guard must match full payer/payee handles, not merely an undirected pair entry.

embargo_selected_effect.summary: Positive/negative effect routes calla6fe20 on actor's target relation with DL=1/0. The helper doubles that bool, clears mask0x02 at record+46 then ORs the new bit. Selected outgoing embargo state is record+46 &0x02, not the truce mask and not a cloned relation object. Dirty/cache marks are also written and must not be mistaken for embargo truth.

subsidy_duration_years.summary: The GUI defaults dialog+2b4 to10, labels it YEARS, increments/decrements by10 and clamps to10..400. Submit copies it unchanged to action+44. Persistent subsidy expiry tests start_date+duration*0x2238 against current raw date. Thus the native scalar is years, not months. Existing public duration_months must not be copied directly; this design proposes duration_years with the reviewed UI domain. UI bounds are not claimed universal engine validation.
subsidy_duration_years.public_parameter_mismatch: Current give_subsidies schema uses duration_months; explicit schema migration or checked conversion is required

observer_scope: Explicit indexed pair relations or outgoing embargo bit; not effective movement permission, request causality, reply acceptance or global world identity.
